subject.name: NEC Computer Engineering Registration Examination
subject.description: Official syllabus for Nepal Engineering Council (NEC) Computer Engineering license examination (Chapters 1-10).

units.title: Concept of Basic Electrical and Electronics Engineering
units.description: DC/AC circuits, network theorems, semiconductor devices, signal generators, and amplifiers.

topics.title: Basic Concept (Ohm's Law, KCL/KVL, Star-Delta, Circuit Classifications)
Network Theorems (Superposition, Thevenin, Norton, Max Power, RLC Resonance)
AC Fundamentals (Waveforms, RMS, Average, 3-Phase Systems)
Semiconductor Devices (Diodes, BJT Biasing, MOSFET, CMOS)
Signal Generators (Oscillators, RC/LC, Crystal Oscillators)
Amplifiers (Class A/B/AB, Tuned, Op-Amps)

units.title: Digital Logic and Microprocessor
units.description: Boolean algebra, combinational & sequential circuits, microprocessor architecture, I/O interfacing, and interrupts.

topics.title: Digital Logic (Number Systems, Boolean Algebra, SOP/POS, K-Maps)
Combinational & Arithmetic Circuits (Mux/Demux, Decoders, Encoders, Adders)
Sequential Logic (Flip-Flops, Registers, Shift Registers, Counters)
Microprocessor (Internal Architecture, 8085/8086, Assembly Programming)
Microprocessor System (Memory Hierarchy, PPI 8255, Serial I/O, DMA)
Interrupt Operations (Interrupts, ISR, Interrupt Processing Priority)

units.title: Programming Language and Its Applications
units.description: C programming, pointers, files, C++ OOP constructs, virtual functions, templates, and STL.

topics.title: Introduction to C Programming (Tokens, Control Flow, Functions, Arrays, Strings)
Pointers, Structures, and File Handling in C
C++ Classes and Objects (Constructors, Destructors, Static, Friend)
OOP Features (Operator Overloading, Inheritance Hierarchies)
Virtual Functions, Dynamic Binding, and Stream I/O
Templates, STL (Containers, Algorithms, Iterators), and Exception Handling

units.title: Computer Organization and Embedded System
units.description: CPU control unit, memory hierarchy, cache design, pipelining, multiprocessors, embedded systems, RTOS, and VHDL.

topics.title: Control & CPU (Microinstructions, Hardwired/Microprogrammed CU, RISC vs CISC, Pipelining)
Memory System & Cache (Cache Principles, Mapping, Replacement, Write Policies)
I/O Organization & Multiprocessors (DMA, Bus Interconnection, Cache Coherence)
Hardware-Software Design in Embedded Systems (ASIP, Custom Processors)
Real-Time Operating & Control Systems (RTOS Scheduling, Synchronization, Drivers)
Hardware Description Language & IC Technology (VHDL Combinational/Sequential, FPGA)

units.title: Concept of Computer Network and Network Security System
units.description: OSI & TCP/IP layers, routing protocols, transport protocols, socket programming, cryptography, and network security.

topics.title: Physical Layer & Network Models (OSI, TCP/IP, Media, Hubs/Switches)
Data Link Layer (Framing, Error Detection, CSMA/CD, Ethernet, ARP, PPP)
Network Layer (Subnetting, CIDR, RIP, OSPF, BGP, Dijkstra, IPv6)
Transport Layer (TCP, UDP, Sockets, Flow & Congestion Control)
Application Layer & Protocols (HTTP/S, DNS, SMTP, Traffic Analyzers)
Network Security (RSA, Digital Signatures, SSL/TLS, IPsec, VPN, Firewalls)

units.title: Theory of Computation and Computer Graphics
units.description: Automata, CFG, Turing machines, computability, 2D/3D transformations, viewing pipelines, and clipping algorithms.

topics.title: Finite Automata (DFA, NFA, Regular Expressions, Pumping Lemma)
Context Free Languages & Pushdown Automata (CFG, CNF, GNF, PDA)
Turing Machines & Complexity (Universal TM, Church-Turing, P vs NP, Decidability)
Computer Graphics Fundamentals (Raster/Vector Displays, Frame Buffers)
2D Transformations & Clipping (Translation, Rotation, Scaling, Cohen-Sutherland)
3D Transformations & Projections (Orthographic, Perspective, Viewing Pipeline)

units.title: Data Structures, Database System and Operating System
units.description: Linear/non-linear data structures, trees, graphs, sorting, searching, relational DBMS, SQL, transactions, and OS process/memory management.

topics.title: Data Structures (Stack, Queue, Postfix, Linked Lists, Trees, AVL)
Sorting, Searching & Graphs (Quick, Merge, Heap, Hashing, DFS/BFS, Dijkstra)
Relational Databases & SQL (ER Modeling, Normalization 1NF-BCNF, Relational Algebra)
Transactions & Concurrency (ACID, 2PL Locks, Deadlocks, WAL Recovery)
Operating Systems & Concurrency (Processes, Threads, CPU Scheduling, Semaphores)
Memory & File Systems (Virtual Memory, Demand Paging, Page Replacement, Disk Scheduling)

units.title: Software Engineering and Object-Oriented Analysis & Design
units.description: Software process models, requirements engineering, architectural design, software testing, SQA, UML, and OOAD patterns.

topics.title: Software Processes & Requirements (Agile, V-Model, SRS, Functional/Non-functional)
Software Architecture & Design (Client-Server, Microservices, Modularity)
Software Testing & SQA (Unit, Integration, System, Black/White Box, CMMI, SQA)
OO Analysis Fundamentals (Use Cases, Domain Modeling, UML Behavioral)
OO Design & Patterns (Class Diagrams, Interaction Diagrams, GoF Design Patterns)
OO Implementation & Mapping (Design to Code, Refactoring, Error Handling)

units.title: Artificial Intelligence and Neural Networks
units.description: Intelligent agents, uninformed/informed search, logic & knowledge representation, NLP, machine learning, and neural networks.

topics.title: AI & Intelligent Agents (PEAS Agent Model, Environment Classifications)
Search Techniques (DFS, BFS, A*, Hill Climbing, Minimax, Alpha-Beta)
Knowledge Representation (Propositional Logic, First-Order Logic, Bayes Nets)
Expert Systems & NLP (Inference Engines, NLP Pipeline, Machine Vision)
Machine Learning (Supervised, Unsupervised, Decision Trees, Naive Bayes, GA)
Neural Networks (Perceptrons, Multilayer Perceptron, Backpropagation, Hopfield)

units.title: Project Planning, Design and Implementation
units.description: Engineering drawings, engineering economics (NPV, IRR), project scheduling (CPM, PERT), contract & tender, ethics, and NEC Act & Regulations.

topics.title: Engineering Drawings (Drawing Scales, Orthographic, Isometric Projections)
Engineering Economics (Cash Flows, NPV, IRR, MARR, Depreciation & Taxes in Nepal)
Project Scheduling (Work Breakdown, CPM, PERT, Resource Leveling)
Project Management (Tendering, Contracts, Risk Management in Nepal)
Engineering Professional Practice (Ethics, NEA Roles & Responsibilities, OHS)
Engineering Regulatory Body (Nepal Engineering Council Act 2055 & Regulations)
